description: Agent Goals: submit the goal report sent to the principal, with the goal record behind it: its title, the goal it reports on, the period it covers and its text, read for wording such as on track, no blockers or nearly done; for the goal’s standing (met, on track, at risk or off track), its progress as a percent of the success test, its open blockers and the changes made to it, whether the report states each, what it states and whether each links to the goal record behind it; and optionally the goal record’s standing, progress, open blockers and changes. The signed report gives the report with any wording that calls the goal safe, each part with whether it is stated, what it states and whether it is backed by the record, and the record, and names a report that flatters the goal record: a better standing, more progress, fewer blockers or fewer changes than the record shows, parts with no link to the record, and wording such as on track or no blockers while the record shows the goal at risk, off track or blocked; then parts left out, parts misstated the other way and a report that does not name its goal, with the fix for each. This reports one goal to its principal against the goal record: a kept-promises report is wever_commitment-report-check, a learning report is wever_learning-report-check and a triage report is wever_triage-report-check. Verdict goal_report_inflated, goal_report_partial, goal_report_missing or goal_report_sound. POST /api/goal-report-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.
